description: This file defines a feature in a C# application related to retrieving profile details, including a request query, validation, and a handler for processing profile read requests.

classes.name: Details.Query
classes.description: A request object containing the username to fetch profile details.

classes.name: Details.QueryValidator
classes.description: Validates that the username in the query is not empty.

classes.name: Details.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the profile detail request by reading profile data via injected profileReader.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the query to retrieve profile information asynchronously using the profileReader.
